findings.claim: Hyatt 10-K 風險因素列出國際營運風險包括進出口許可要求與未預期的法規變動，含關稅、禁運、出口管制與其他貿易限制（一般性風險揭露，未量化）
findings.excerpt: import and export licensing requirements and regulations, as well as unforeseen changes in regulatory requirements, including the imposition of tariffs or embargoes, export regulations, controls, and other trade restrictions;

findings.claim: 10-K 載明營運受 OFAC 與商務部貿易制裁約束，且 2025 年無需依 ITRSHR Act 揭露的活動
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1 International Operations
findings.excerpt: We did not identify any 2025 activities required to be disclosed.

findings.claim: Skift 報導 2026 年 2 月全球關稅政策急變讓部分飯店營運商及其供應商感到混亂（產業層級，非 Hyatt 專屬）
findings.source: Skift, Hoteliers Scramble to Price U.S. Tariff Risk
findings.excerpt: President Trump announced a 10% global tariff Friday and said Saturday he planned to raise it to 15%. The sudden shifts created confusion among some hotel operators and their suppliers.

note: 搜尋未找到 Hyatt 專屬的關稅、Section 232、實體清單或中國貿易限制揭露；Hyatt 未見於 2026 年出口管制名單搜尋結果。
